sample_unit: raters (5 gastroenterologists and 50 patients) scoring H. pylori patient education materials

links.outcome: Readability of LLM and physician patient education materials against sixth-grade target
links.effect: No patient education material, from any LLM or the physician, met the recommended sixth-grade reading level on Flesch-Kincaid and SMOG, despite explicit instruction to write at that level.
links.quote: No PEM met the recommended sixth-grade reading level.

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM-generated patient education materials against physician-written materials
Rating LLM patient materials for completeness and comprehensibility from both patient and gastroenterologist perspectives

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of LLM-generated patient education materials compared to physician-written materials using clinician and patient raters, without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
